evals.prompt: /issue add dark mode support to the settings page
evals.expected_output: Claude should: (1) confirm the current branch is appropriate, (2) draft an issue body with ## 背景 / ## 達成基準 / ## 注釈 sections in Japanese, (3) show the draft and ask for confirmation, (4) after confirmation create the issue via `gh issue create`, (5) create a worktree with branch name like `issue-N-add-dark-mode`, (6) report the issue URL and branch/worktree path.

assertions.text: Issue body draft contains all three Japanese sections: ## 背景, ## 達成基準, ## 注釈
Claude asks the user to confirm or refine the draft before creating the issue
Branch name follows the issue-{N}-{slug} pattern
Claude references `scripts/build_codex_prompt.sh` when delegating to Codex

evals.expected_output: When called without arguments, Claude should ask for the issue title first, then proceed to draft the body. The interaction should be conversational and not skip the confirmation step.

assertions.text: Claude asks for the issue title when no $ARGUMENTS are provided
Claude drafts the issue body and shows it to the user before creating the issue

evals.prompt: 新しいissueを作りたい。ログイン時にパスワードリセットが機能しないバグを修正したい。
evals.expected_output: Even without the explicit /issue prefix, Claude should recognize this as an issue creation request and follow the skill workflow. The issue body should correctly identify this as a bug fix with appropriate 達成基準.

assertions.text: Claude recognizes this as a request to create a GitHub issue
Issue body draft correctly frames this as a bug fix in the 背景 section
達成基準 includes specific, testable acceptance criteria for the password reset fix
